title: bauhinia stenoloba
intro: Bauhinia stenoloba, commonly known as the pink orchid tree, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant is believed to have health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing fever, relieving cough, and treating wounds. The bioactive constituents of Bauhinia stenoloba include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
